method: A local, self-hosted Penpot 2.19.5 from the official container images, reachable only from the same machine, with a throwaway account. pocket-invoice.penpot imported as a new file and opened in the workspace with Playwright (Chromium). The plugin in scripts/ux-pathway/plugin-write-check (manifest version 2, permissions content:read and content:write) served from the same machine, installed from its manifest URL in the Plugin Manager, its permissions allowed in Penpot's dialog, and opened from the manager. It writes a board, a rectangle and a text with penpot.createBoard(), penpot.createRectangle() and penpot.createText(). The file then read back with get-file in a new API session and exported with export-binfile.

notChecked: The Penpot MCP server: only the Plugin API, through the Plugin Manager, was used.
Penpot cloud (penpot.app, design.penpot.app): only a self-hosted instance was used.
Figma: nothing here touches Figma or a Figma file.
A person's own editing: the plugin was installed, allowed and opened by Playwright clicking the Plugin Manager as a person would, but no person edited the file.
Other plugin permissions (library, comments, user, downloads) and plugins from the public plugin list.

Penpot with its Content-Security-Policy enforced (PENPOT_CSP_MODE=enforce): 2.19.5 ships it report-only, and the browser logged that framing the plugin UI from another origin breaks frame-src 'self' (see browserConsoleErrors); an enforcing deployment needs PENPOT_CSP_FRAME_SRC_EXTRA for the plugin origin.
